name: University of California, Los Angeles
description: The University of California, Los Angeles is a public research university in Los Angeles, founded in 1919 as part of the University of California. It is known for the sciences, engineering, psychology and the arts.
whyIncluded: UCLA's alumni association runs a Singapore Network, founded in 2002, for UCLA graduates living or working in Singapore.

livingCosts.summary: UCLA's own budget for an undergraduate living on campus for the academic year: housing, food, transport, books and personal costs. Excludes tuition, fees and health insurance.
livingCosts.notes: 2026-27 undergraduate cost of attendance, on campus: housing $12,299; food $7,568; transportation $969; books, course materials, supplies and equipment $1,588 + personal $2,761 = personal. Months not stated; academic year (three quarters) taken as 9 months.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering BS
programmes.feeBasis: UCLA's 2026-27 nonresident undergraduate tuition plus nonresident supplement for new students (same for every major and fixed for your entering year), plus campus fees.
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international (nonresident) undergraduates at UCLA, same for all majors, plus campus fees. Tuition is fixed for your entering class; campus fees can change. Health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: UCLA Financial Aid cost of attendance, 2026-27 undergraduate (new students), nonresident: University Fees $16,430 = UC Systemwide Tuition $15,588 + campus fees $842; Nonresident Supplemental Tuition $39,270. Tuition here = UC systemwide tuition (which UCLA's figure combines with the Student Services Fee) + NRST = $54,858; other fees = campus fees $842. Health insurance $3,885 excluded (waivable). Under the UC Tuition Stability Plan, UC tuition, NRST and the Student Services Fee stay flat for each entering undergraduate class for up to six years (registrar fee descriptions), so cohort-locked; campus fees can change. 2025 history: the same page's table for 'Continuing Students Who Started in the 2025-26 Academic Year': UC Systemwide Tuition $14,934 + NRST $37,602 = $52,536, campus fees $842. Same rate for all majors. Figures may be proposed, not final. Document fee for new students not shown, so 0. Samueli School of Engineering. 2024 history: the same page's table for 'Continuing Students Who Started in the 2024-25 Academic Year' (read 2026-10-13): UC Systemwide Tuition $14,436 + NRST $34,200 = $48,636, campus fees $842.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering MS
programmes.feeBasis: UCLA's 2026-27 standard nonresident graduate tuition plus nonresident supplement, which applies to academic master's degrees like this one, plus campus fees.
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international (nonresident) graduate students at UCLA, plus campus fees. Graduate tuition is set each year; health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: Samueli School of Engineering. UCLA Financial Aid cost of attendance, 2026-27 graduate, nonresident: University Fees $15,608 = UC Systemwide Tuition $15,066 + campus fees $542; Nonresident Supplemental Tuition $15,102. Tuition here = $15,066 + $15,102 = $30,168; other fees = campus fees $542. Health insurance $7,515 excluded. Graduate tuition is set each year (not cohort-locked). This is the academic graduate rate; no Professional Degree Supplemental Tuition is shown for it. Duration typical. History from the UC Office of the President systemwide fee-level PDFs (read 2026-10-13; the 2026-27 PDF gives graduate Tuition $13,722 + Student Services Fee $1,344 = the $15,066 above, so same basis): 2025-26 graduate Tuition $13,140 + Student Services Fee $1,290 + graduate academic NRST $15,102 = $29,532; 2024-25 $12,762 + $1,254 + $15,102 = $29,118. UCLA campus fees for graduate students in those years were not found (UCLA's own fee page is a script-only app and the graduate cost of attendance shows 2026-27 only), so the rows carry tuition only and the current campus fees apply.
